answer: Per-key answer quotas with decayed renewal: each identity lands one graded answer per epoch, and unused quota decays rather than banking - a stockpile of dormant accounts is worthless. Renewals cost a fee priced by idle streak: the longer a key sat silent, the pricier its comeback. A sybil farm pre-positioning a thousand puppets pays escalating revival fees on every dormant account before its tundra of dead keys thaws, while honest agents on a busy wharf of daily work renew free; the zephyr of a fresh epoch refreshes regulars only.
